column1: # One line per Table 1 row. type: one = positives/negatives from gt/cand files on one sample (the collection's own
# ground truth, positives = gt, negatives = cand minus gt); two = positives are the gt positions on the modified sample,
# negatives the same positions on its unmodified control (datasets = modified,control; contigs of the control are
# prefixed NEG_ at scoring time). gt/cand: comma-separated files relative to the dataset's gtdir (absolute paths allowed);
# cand "same" = the gt positions; "refbase:T" = every position whose reference base is T on either strand. context:
# all | cpg | noncpg (split with the dataset's reference). mincov = coverage floor; only candidate positions covered
# by >= mincov reads of sub.bam are scored, and among those, positions the tool never scored count as unmodified (0).
# NOTE (Sep 27): the collection's candidate.bed / cand_*.bed files for the BACTERIA hold only the positives (no
# negatives), so bacterial rows use refbase:<B>: every covered position of the modified base is a candidate.
